meta.title: AI Passport Connector
meta.description: Turn AI Passport into a portable DSH voice assistant with Wi-Fi conversations, Host speech recognition, Agent presets and TTS replies.

config.$description: Enable the connector, then generate a four-digit pairing code and enable LAN access. Enter the computer IP and code on the device.
config.host: Listen address (0.0.0.0 allows LAN device access)
config.port: Listen port (default 3101; match the device setup)
config.accessToken: Device pairing code (four digits; match the device)
config.deviceId: Allowed device ID (blank accepts the first authenticated device)
config.agentPreset: Agent preset ID (default whale-girl, the plugin Whale Girl)
config.cwd: Working directory (defaults to passport/workspace under the user directory; created if missing)
config.maxRecordingSeconds: Maximum recording (seconds; oversized input is discarded)
config.maxReplySeconds: Maximum spoken reply (seconds; longer replies are not spoken)
config.requestTimeoutMs: Whole-request timeout (ms; recognition, conversation and playback)
config.sessionRevision: Conversation refresh identifier (managed by the new conversation action)
